name: congress-bills
description: Nodes represent legislators. Each hyperedge represents a bill and contains the set of legislators associated with that bill (e.g., sponsor and cosponsor lists).

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., congress-bills).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., true).

nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Legislator name with state and district (e.g., Dayton, Mark [MN]).
